cards.title: RSL crossing is not working
cards.meaning: High volume, low return. The delivery is poor or the defense is winning the ball in the air.
cards.watch: Expect a change: cutbacks, play through the middle, or a target forward off the bench.
cards.rule: Crosses >= 5 and completion < 25% in the first half.

cards.title: RSL are trailing and will push
cards.meaning: Teams that are behind commit more players forward and take more risk.
cards.watch: RSL fullbacks higher, an extra attacker on, more crosses. That also leaves space behind them for a counter.

cards.title: Demo United are creating real chances with few shots
cards.meaning: What they are doing works. Expect more of it.
cards.watch: The same pattern of attack repeating, the opponent forced to change shape.

cards.title: RSL shots are not testing the keeper
cards.meaning: Volume without threat. Likely long shots or blocked attempts.
cards.watch: More patience in the final third, or a change of player to create better shots.
cards.rule: Shots >= 6 and shots on target share < 25%.

cards.title: Demo United are ahead and may sit deeper
cards.meaning: Teams that are ahead protect the lead and let the opponent have the ball.
cards.watch: A lower Demo United line, fewer players forward, counters when they win it. Possession tends to shift toward the opponent.

cards.title: RSL may bring on a target forward
cards.meaning: A team crossing this much and behind often adds a tall striker to use the deliveries.
cards.watch: A substitution around minute 55 to 65 for a big forward, crosses aimed at the penalty spot.

cards.title: Demo United are under pressure and may add a defender
cards.data: Opponent shots 9 in the first half.
cards.meaning: A team being outshot like this often changes shape to protect the box.
cards.watch: A back five or an extra holding midfielder for Demo United, a winger dropping in to track the fullback.
cards.rule: Opponent shots >= 8 and team is not behind.

cards.title: Demo United are crossing less than normal
cards.data: Demo United first half crosses: 3 vs season norm 8 per half.
cards.meaning: They are not reaching the byline.
cards.watch: Play through the middle, fullbacks held back.
cards.rule: First half value differs from the season half-norm by 15% or more (8 points for possession).

cards.title: RSL are shooting more than normal
cards.data: RSL first half shots: 9 vs season norm 7 per half.
cards.meaning: They are getting into shooting positions more often.
cards.watch: More box entries, the opponent blocking and clearing more.
cards.rule: First half value differs from the season half-norm by 15% or more (8 points for possession).

cards.title: Demo United are passing less than normal
cards.data: Demo United first half passes: 170 vs season norm 244 per half.
cards.meaning: The game is stretched, more direct, or they are under pressure.
cards.watch: Long balls, quick transitions, fewer long possessions.
cards.rule: First half value differs from the season half-norm by 15% or more (8 points for possession).

working.meaning: What they are doing works. Expect more of it.
working.watch: The same pattern of attack repeating, the opponent forced to change shape.
